answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making every identity carry its own underwriting policy. An insurer prices each premium from that agent's verified work history and claws back fraud payouts from the certifying insurer, so it audits first, demanding quartz-hard escrow collateral and rejecting records that are a timber facade of fabricated reviews. No bulk deals: a plume of a thousand fresh puppets means a thousand full-price policies, no volume discount, so an army costs N times what one honest agent pays once; sybil profit evaporates.
